descriptionChirho: The proper place name Yarmuth (יַרְמוּת), a Canaanite royal city in the Shephelah of Judah whose king Piram joined the coalition against Gibeon (Josh 10:3,5,23; 12:11) and which was later allotted to the tribe of Judah (Josh 15:35). Also appears as a Levitical city in Issachar (Neh 11:29). English renders Yarmut/Yarmuth; Spanish Jarmut; Hindi यर्मूत (Yarmut); Arabic يَرْمُوتَ (Yarmuta); Korean 야르뭃/야르뭇 (Yarumut); Swahili Yarmuthi. The second cluster simply has conjunctive and prepositional prefixes (and-in-Yarmuth) but denotes the identical city. All 7 occurrences are the same toponym.
